DLC2307:4:t_008:7.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「The Empire's machines use $$次元力$$ in their control systems.」

DLC2307:4:t_008:8.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Shielded mobile weapons are another matter, but when the infantry is exposed to $$バサラ$$'s singing, their functions are disrupted.」

DLC2307:4:t_008:10.en:
$$黒の騎士団$$
「This song...! It's filling me with courage!」

DLC2307:4:t_008:11.en:
$$黒の騎士団$$
「Let's do it! We can do this!!」

DLC2307:4:t_009:2.en:
$$扇$$
「Good! Now we can carry out Plan 8C!」

DLC2307:4:t_009:3.en:
$$扇$$
「Everyone! Drive the $$バイオロイド$$s back!!」

DLC2307:4:t_011:1.en:
$$玉城$$
「All right! Get a taste of a tactic taught by $$ゼロ$$ himself!!」

DLC2307:4:t_013:0.en:
$$リヴァル$$
「We did it! We caught them all at once!!」

DLC2307:4:t_013:1.en:
$$玉城$$
「Did you see that!? The power of $$ゼロ$$'s brains and the trap I set as the $$新日本$$ volunteer army's engineering captain!!」

DLC2307:4:t_013:2.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「We came to $$新日本$$ because $$ゼロ$$ asked us to put on a concert, but...」

DLC2307:4:t_013:3.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「Crashing a battlefield is nothing new, but this has turned into something incredible...」

DLC2307:4:t_014:0.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「That's $$熱気バサラ$$ for you. He's worked a miracle.」

DLC2307:4:t_015:0.en:
$$スザク$$
「$$藤堂$$ contacted us. He says the reinforcements that just arrived are the enemy's last forces.」

DLC2307:4:t_015:1.en:
$$カレン$$
「Then once we take them out, $$トウキョウ$$ will be safe!」

DLC2307:4:t_015:2.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「We'll help you, $$黒の騎士団$$!」

DLC2307:4:t_016:0.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「We'll close this miraculous concert with a victory! All units, go on the offensive!」

DLC2307:4:t_016:2.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「We'll fight! $$バサラ$$, you sing!!」

DLC2307:4:t_016:3.en:
$$バサラ$$
「I was planning to, whether you told me to or not!」

DLC2307:4:t_016:4.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Here we go, $$トウキョウ$$! LISTEN TO MY SOOOONG!!」

DLC2307:4:t_017:1.en:
$$スザク$$
「Apparently the fighting in the other regions and on $$藤堂$$'s front is over too.」

DLC2307:4:t_017:2.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「This should stall the Empire's invasion of $$新日本$$.」

DLC2307:4:t_018:0.en:
$$バサラ$$
「This concert's only just begun! HERE WE GOOO!!」

DLC2307:4:t_020:0.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「Even $$ゼロ$$ the miracle-worker is outshone today.」

DLC2307:4:t_020:2.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「I can bring victory, but I can't bring smiles to people's faces.」

DLC2307:4:t_021:1.en:
$$ゼロ$$
（Whatever that ship was carrying... That's probably the enemy's real objective.）

DLC2307:4:t_021:2.en:
$$ゼロ$$
（I have a response ready, but we have to hurry.）

DLC2307:4:t_023:0.en:
$$玉城$$
「Wooo! My heart's charging in too!!」

DLC2307:4:t_023:1.en:
$$扇$$
「Our job isn't to charge in! It's to guide the civilians to safety!」

DLC2307:4:t_024:0.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「This time, listen to MY soooong!!」

DLC2307:4:t_025:0.en:
$$リヴァル$$
「It's one of $$ミレーヌ$$'s numbers this time!」

DLC2307:4:t_025:2.en:
$$ニーナ$$
「It's a nice song, $$ミレイ$$.」

DLC2307:4:t_100:0.en:
$$ゼロ$$
（Citizens and volunteers alike fight with firm resolve now. But this war... will likely be longer and harsher than any before...）

DLC2307:4:t_100:1.en:
$$ゼロ$$
（When that happens, will their spirits be able to endure it...?）

DLC2307:4:t_101:0.en:
$$ゼロ$$
（I brought $$Ｆｉｒｅ　Ｂｏｍｂｅｒ$$ here to encourage the citizens. To think it would lead to this.）

DLC2307:4:t_101:1.en:
$$ゼロ$$
（Heh... Just for today, I'll enjoy this miracle too.）

DLC2307:4:t_102:1.en:
$$スザク$$
（Dad... This time, I will protect this country...!）

DLC2307:4:t_103:0.en:
$$カレン$$
（$$リヴァル$$, $$ニーナ$$, President... And Mom...）

DLC2307:4:t_103:1.en:
$$カレン$$
（I'll protect them, no matter what...! This country, and the people I care about!）

DLC2307:4:t_104:0.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
（Now then, $$ルルーシュ$$... It looks like we'll need miracles by the dozen to win the battles ahead.）

DLC2307:4:t_104:1.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
（Show me. Show me the road to victory you'll lead us down.）

DLC2307:4:t_105:0.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「Do you think $$ゼロ$$ called us here aiming for exactly this timing...?」

DLC2307:4:t_105:1.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「Even he couldn't predict $$バサラ$$'s actions perfectly, I think...」

DLC2307:4:t_105:2.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「Then this situation is the result of several coincidences coming together.」

DLC2307:4:t_105:3.en:
$$レイ#pt231$$
「Since we've got the chance, why don't we call it the Miracle $$トウキョウ$$ Concert?」

DLC2307:4:t_105:4.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「Good idea. That sounds more like it.」

DLC2307:4:t_105:5.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「Then let's do our best to live up to that name!」

DLC2307:4:t_105:6.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Here we go, $$トウキョウ$$! LISTEN TO MY SOOOOONG!!」

review.context: Basara's singing disrupts the robot infantry and rallies the Black Knights, allowing Tamaki to spring Zero's trap. After victory the concert continues, while Zero and C.C. contemplate the hard war ahead.
decisions: Ray is the Fire Bomber musician, using token pt231 rather than SEED's Rey or Evangelion's Rei.
Dimensional Power disrupts unshielded infantry controls; the explanation explicitly distinguishes shielded mobile weapons.
Tamaki's heart-charging joke echoes the preceding song title; Ohgi redirects him to evacuation duty.
MY FRIENDS and DYNAMITE EXPLOSION remain song titles, with no lyrics added.
Measured-fit revision preserves all source details with more concise wording; all six triads remain in the AG list where applicable.
